THIS AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO OPERATING AGREEMENT (this "Amendment") of Ordinary
Company LLC, a Florida protected series limited liability company (the "Company"), is made effective
as of September 21, 2026, by the undersigned sole member (the "Member").

2026 (the "Agreement").

instrument signed by the Member.
C. The Member wishes to amend the Agreement as set forth in this Amendment.
NOW, THEREFORE, the Member amends the Agreement as follows:
